title: MCP Client
description: Connects to an external MCP server and exposes its tools for agent tool-calling.
Transports: STDIO (local subprocess), Streamable HTTP (modern), and legacy HTTP+SSE.

mcp_client.commandLine.title: Command line
mcp_client.commandLine.description: Command line to launch MCP server (stdio transport). Example: python -m rocketride_mcp

mcp_client.endpoint.title: Endpoint
mcp_client.endpoint.description: MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint URL. Example: http(s)://host:port/mcp

mcp_client.sse_endpoint.title: SSE endpoint (legacy)
mcp_client.sse_endpoint.description: Legacy MCP SSE URL (old transport). Example: http://127.0.0.1:8000/sse

mcp_client.headers.title: Headers
mcp_client.headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for streamable-http/sse transports

properties.title: Transport
properties.description: How to connect to the MCP server
